lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots distributed across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal alignment of spots to create a grid-like structural pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two continuous horizontal ridges situated on the upper lateral flank, defined by a distinct intensity transition between the illuminated dorsal surface and the shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed high-contrast spot distribution on the leading edge and ventral surface of the visible pectoral fin.
